title: Sara Duterte: NBI probe into properties aims to derail presidential bid

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said that the National Bureau of Investigation’s (NBI) probe into the alleged misdeclaration of properties in her statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALNs) was meant to derail her 2028 presidential bid. The NBI’s initial findings also implicated her brother, Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte, in the alleged misdeclaration.
